sara (PM): Quick sync: ACME wants a gated pilot for eval-triggered alerts + quantization suggestions. Key asks: tenant opt-in, webhook + weekly digest, and an "apply-as-proposal" flow (customer approval required).

kai (Eng): Implementation split: detect pipeline -> alert dispatcher -> recs engine -> console + API. Feature flags mandatory. Canary: internal -> alpha tenants -> open pilot.

anika (ML): Recommend primary signal = concordance_p90 (less noisy), secondary = hallucination_rate_top10. Detect regressions vs 7d baseline. Default threshold = 5% relative.

miguel (CS): CS asks: HMAC-signed webhook, weekly JSON digest, and an audit-nonce for "Apply" actions. Customers want a preview in staging before GA. Also request revert button and impact summary.

vera (Legal): We need clear opt-in language and retention limits for eval traces. No PII in payloads. Consent must be revocable and recorded.

nina (Support): From support: provide an "explain" field in the alert (short bullet) so L1 can triage quickly. Weekly digest email helpful.

sara (PM): Draft pilot acceptance (proposal): 1) Pilot with internal + 2 alpha tenants; 2) Alert precision >= 70% on top-100 prompts; 3) When customers apply quant recs, end-to-end quality delta <1% in >= 85% of cases; 4) Median time-to-detect <= 7 days. Pilot = 6 weeks.

anika (ML): For quant scoring, propose a normalized metric: score = (100*quality_delta_pct) - (latency_gain_ms/100) - (cost_savings_pct). Recommend if score <= 1.8. Will run sims on 5 customers and share ROC/PR curves.

kai (Eng): Risks: per-tenant eval retention cost, pager storms from simultaneous alerts, and complexity of per-tenant thresholds. Mitigations: compressed deltas, alert rate cap, tenant-tiered thresholds.

miguel (CS): API ask: expose POST /v1/tenants/{t}/recommendations with signed webhook and audit header. Include apply_mode: "proposal" or "auto-apply" (auto only on Dedicated with explicit contract).

ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/optimize-eval-pilot-2026 on branch feat/optimize-eval. Staging deployed. CI job started. :rocket:

sara (PM): Owners & next steps: ML -> sims + scoring by EOW; Eng -> epic cards + rough estimates by Tue; CS -> recruit 2 alphas and draft consent; Legal -> sign-off on opt-in text. Weekly check-ins here.

anika (ML): Acknowledged. I'll attach simulation summary to this thread when ready.

kai (Eng): Will add backlog items and initial sizing. Also will prototype a webhook payload example in the doc.

miguel (CS): Reaching out to ACME today to confirm staging endpoints and rollback SLA.

sara (PM): Thanks team. If no objections to the gates, I'll convert this into a 1-page PRD and tag owners. :thumbsup:
